title: Volume Analysis: The Correct Way to Read & Understand the Market
description:
Most traders see candles going up and down. But they're missing the truth serum of the market: Volume. Learn how to read volume like a pro with ONE mental model.

📌 What You'll Learn:
• The Effort vs Result mental model (changes everything)
• 3 VSA patterns every trader must recognize
• Why volume bar COLOR is misleading (and what to look at instead)
• Volume divergence—your free early warning system
• The 3-Step Volume Check you can use today
